# IFN response and OA markers (clean)

Differential expression analysis in the IFN-stimulated cohort revealed strong upregulation of antiviral ISGs. IFIT1 was strongly upregulated (Table 2). ISG15 was upregulated in the treated arm (Table 2). OAS1 was upregulated in the IFN donor samples (Table 2). IFIT3 was upregulated as expected for the ISG cluster (Table 2). MX1 was upregulated (Table 2).

Cartilage matrix genes were downregulated in this inflammatory context. ACAN was downregulated (Table 2). COL2A1 was downregulated (Table 2).

HMOX1 was modestly upregulated near the significance threshold (Table 2). GAPDH expression was essentially unchanged at baseline (Table 2).
